bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer from Yerevan with {{years}}+ years of experience building production web applications with Python (Django, FastAPI) and React with TypeScript.

I enjoy the whole journey of a feature: designing the API and database, securing it with JWT and role-based access, and turning it into a fast, accessible interface. Lately I've been building large SPAs with Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, React Hook Form and Zod.
I'm open to new opportunities where I can take ownership of features end to end, work with a strong team, and keep growing.

skills.intro: Technologies I use to design, build and ship web applications.

bullets: Developed full-stack applications with React.js, Redux/MobX, Python (Django, FastAPI), PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy.
Implemented role-based access control and JWT authentication with access and refresh tokens.
Built REST APIs with Django Ninja and integrated frontend applications with backend services and databases.
Processed CSV data with Pandas and generated automated PDF reports using FPDF.
Wrote unit and integration tests for business logic, APIs and application workflows.
Used Claude Code for AI-assisted research, debugging and refactoring.
Developed and maintained a large-scale property management SPA with React.js, TypeScript, Vite and MUI.
Built reusable UI components, data tables, forms and a feature-based architecture across multiple business modules.
Integrated REST APIs with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, including caching, invalidation, authentication and automatic token refresh.
Implemented role-based access control, protected routes, a bilingual English/French UI and responsive layouts.
Built configuration-driven forms with React Hook Form and Zod, including validation, error handling and data workflows.
Contributed to deployment and delivery with Git/GitHub and Azure Static Web Apps.

projects.intro: A selection of things I've built. More coming soon.
projects.private: Private client code, available to discuss in an interview

propertyManagement.title: Property Management Platform
propertyManagement.description: A back-office platform for condominium associations, used by property managers, administrators and building presidents to run daily operations and accounting. I built the frontend: a bilingual (English/French), role-aware SPA of about 48,000 lines of TypeScript.
highlights: Syndicate, management and accounting modules: buildings and units, suppliers, disputes, service requests, budgets, journals, expenses, collections and bank reconciliations
RTK Query data layer with ~180 typed endpoints, tag-based cache invalidation and silent JWT refresh-and-retry
Config-driven forms with React Hook Form and Zod, plus a generic DataGrid table with server-side pagination and filtering
Role-based access, unsaved-changes guard, custom MUI theme, deployed to Azure Static Web Apps

aiBlogGenerator.title: AI Blog Generator — Management Dashboard
aiBlogGenerator.description: An admin dashboard for an AI pipeline that writes SEO blog posts for many marketing funnels and publishes them to GoHighLevel. I built the frontend that configures each funnel and reviews the generated posts.
highlights: Funnel management: per-funnel OpenAI, Shutterstock and scraped-data settings, plus publishing schedules with time windows and rate limits
OAuth 2.0 connection flows for GoHighLevel and Google Search Console
Generate a post, edit its HTML in place and publish it to the client's blog in one screen
MobX stores, protected routes, Formik + Yup forms and an in-app issue reporter

giftsMarketplace.title: Local Gifts Marketplace & Franchise Platform
giftsMarketplace.description: A gift-card marketplace where shoppers buy gifts from nearby merchants in a mobile app, run by a franchise network. I worked full stack: the FastAPI backend and the React back office for super users, franchisees, sub-franchisees and merchants.
highlights: Franchise territories drawn as polygons on Google Maps and matched to merchants with PostGIS geo queries
Merchant wallets, payouts and withdrawals on Stripe Connect, with transaction and commission history
Celery + Redis jobs for mass email, Firebase push notifications and expiring gifts and promos
Dockerized stack (Nginx, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Flower) deployed through GitLab CI

portfolio.title: This Portfolio — a Desktop OS in the Browser
portfolio.description: The site you're looking at: a desktop-style portfolio with draggable windows, a terminal and a quick view for recruiters, backed by a FastAPI API.
highlights: Window manager with drag, resize, focus and minimize built on Zustand and react-rnd
Three languages (EN/RU/HY), light and dark themes, mobile home-screen layout
Contact form with validation on both ends, stored in PostgreSQL and delivered by email
